Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: After the Planner (in Step 3) explicitly instructed to find the director and birth date(s) for The Musician Killer, WebSurfer ignored that task and continued focusing only on Ghost Town Gold/Joseph Kane. This pattern repeated in later steps (opening or reloading Ghost Town Gold/IMDB pages), never performing the required search for The Musician Killer. The failure to retrieve any information about The Musician Killer’s director made it impossible to compare birth dates and directly led to an incomplete/incorrect resolution of the task.
